action: Keep the app ad-free; never show ads to paying users
v1_evidence: Listing says no ads; no advertising SDK in package.json
measurement_idea: Share of own App Store reviews that mention ads (target: none)

action: Set a simple transparent pricing model before launch
effort_note: A decision; build only if a paid tier is added
v1_evidence: App is free with no in-app purchases (listing, handoff); no revenue model is defined
measurement_idea: Willingness-to-pay survey; share of own reviews that mention price

action: Never lose a user's entries (device first + backup + export)
effort_note: Export through the share sheet is medium; full sync would be large
v1_evidence: Data lives in the phone's key-value store and documents folder; no backup, export or sync code found; handoff says deleting the app deletes the data
measurement_idea: Crash-free sessions and retention (App Store Connect); own reviews that mention lost data

effort_note: Release process and communication; little code
v1_evidence: First release (1.0.0); over-the-air updates are not configured
measurement_idea: Rating by version (App Store Connect); own reviews that mention updates

action: Build the core around pregnancy-week journaling
effort_note: New prompt content plus a small screen
v1_evidence: Daily journal page (title, mood, text, photos), milestone timeline with ideas, photo calendar; multiple photos can be selected. No weekly prompts found
measurement_idea: Day-7 and day-30 retention (App Store Connect); interviews on why people journal

action: Let a partner and family follow along (included in the base plan)
effort_note: Needs accounts and sync, which conflicts with the no-account design
v1_evidence: No accounts and no network access by design, so no sharing
measurement_idea: Survey or fake-door test of demand before building

action: Make the account optional (start with no sign-in)
effort_note: Already account-free; adding optional sync later would be large
measurement_idea: Own reviews that mention login or sign-in (target: none)

effort_note: Copy, role options and a due-date override; some content work
v1_evidence: Due date is entered at onboarding and wording is neutral in places; labels say Mom and no partner role, twins or pregnancy-loss handling was found
measurement_idea: Interviews with LGBTQ+, IVF and surrogacy families; own reviews that mention inclusion

effort_note: PDF export is medium; print and fulfilment is large
v1_evidence: No export or print feature found

action: Add iOS quick-access features later (widgets and Watch)
effort_note: Native extensions are heavy in Expo
v1_evidence: No widget, Watch or Live Activity found; quick moment entry from Home and reminders exist

action: Offer in-app support and easy refunds
v1_evidence: Support URL is a placeholder in the listing; no in-app contact found; no payments, so no refunds

action: Let the user change the due date and state sources for baby-size data
v1_evidence: Due date is entered at onboarding; baby-size card and checkup guide carry a not-medical-advice note; source of figures is not stated in the files read

measurement_idea: Own reviews that mention AI (target: none)

action: Do not sell or share pregnancy data; say plainly what is collected
v1_evidence: Data Not Collected; no network requests; privacy policy drafted but not yet hosted

action: Do not try to out-publish the leaders on articles
v1_evidence: Light reference content only (week-by-week size card, checkup guide)
